subject: MAP: deployment & region gating — proposed sprint schedule and acceptance criteria
messages:
From: Emily Chen <emily.chen@clearpathhealth.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-28T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: MAP kickoff: deployment mode & regions

Hi Rafael,

Thanks for the call earlier. To keep momentum on the MAP, we need a concrete sprint and acceptance criteria to choose between Hosted, Dedicated, and Private for our initial deployment. Key constraints on our side: HIPAA scope for patient notes (data-in-transit & at-rest), need for US-only data residency, and a go-live target (pilot) around 2027-06-15.

Can you send a one-page sprint plan showing:
- Week-by-week evaluation activities (integration, perf, security)
- Decision gates and acceptance tests per mode
- Rough cost envelope for each option (hosted/dedicated/private)

I've attached our MAP template and a short list of stakeholders. Procurement will need the pricing worksheet and SLA text once we have a preferred mode.

Emily Chen
Product Ops, ClearPath Health
emily.chen@clearpathhealth.com
Attachment: clearpath-map-template.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@clearpathhealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-29T10:16:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: deployment mode & regions

Emily — thanks, this is helpful. Drafting the MAP sprint below (attached as MAP-v1.xlsx):

High level sprint (3 weeks)
- Week 0 (baseline): account setup, API keys, small integration impl (hosted) — validate auth, network egress, and sample inference flows.
- Week 1 (functional & perf): run canonical prompts through Hosted; measure latency p50/p95, token costs, and integration edge cases.
- Week 2 (scale & dedicated test): spin a Dedicated pool in our lab with the same model profile; run synthetic load to compare p95 latency and cost at 1k rps equivalent.
- Week 3 (security & private validation): scope Private deployment checklist (KMS, VPC peering, audit logs) and run transfer tests with a narrow dataset.

Decision gates / acceptance criteria (examples)
- Latency: p95 < 200ms for top-90% of user flows under target concurrency (define specific flows).
- Cost: hosted monthly estimated token cost <= 1.5x baseline; if >1.5x, escalate to Dedicated evaluation.
- Compliance: Private only if data residency or KMS controls cannot be satisfied in Hosted/Dedicated.
- Rollout risk: fallback policy established (model variant + region fallback) before pilot.

Proposed timeline (dates anchored to your June 15 pilot):
- MAP sign-off: 2027-04-07
- Integration sprint start: 2027-04-12
- Decision checkpoint (hosted vs dedicated): 2027-05-03
- Private gating complete: 2027-05-24

I've attached the MAP spreadsheet with placeholders for tests and metric owners. Priyom is looping in ops testing details below.

Attachments: MAP-v1.xlsx

Best,
Rafael
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rafael@redwood.com

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>, Emily Chen <emily.chen@clearpathhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-30T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: deployment mode & regions — acceptance tests and canary plan

Adding test detail and a lightweight canary approach.

Acceptance test matrix (dev/prod like):
- Integration smoke: auth, end-to-end inference, sample dataset verification (pass/fail).
- Latency & correctness: run the top 12 production prompts; track semantic drift (BLEU/embedding similarity) and latency p95.
- Cost projection: run 72-hour sample traffic and extrapolate monthly spend with 95% CI.
- Security: validate SOC2 control mapping, KMS integration test, and audit log delivery.

Canary + fallback:
- Start pilot on Hosted (hosted.region-us-west-2) with 10% of traffic. If p95 latency or error rate breaches threshold for 3 consecutive 15-min windows, automatically shift that traffic to Dedicated pool in the same region.
- If Dedicated still fails for compliance/latency, shift only allowed non-PHI flows to multi-region hosted while we stand up Private.

Notes: Laura will own env prep (network/VPC tests) and Priyom will own perf harness. Emily — can you confirm sample prompts and the concurrency target for p95 (e.g., 250 concurrent inference sessions)?

— Priyom
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood

Thanks all — final alignment and ask for sign-off: 

Summary decisions and next steps
- POC path: we will run initial POC on Hosted (us-west-2) starting 2027-04-12. Hosted gives the fastest path to validate integration and model correctness.
- Performance gating: if Hosted cost or p95 latency exceeds thresholds (see MAP-v1.xlsx cells B14-B20), we will provision a Dedicated pool and rerun the perf harness by 2027-05-03.
- Private option: scoped and prepared, but only executed if required for full PHI scope or if KMS/residency cannot be met in Hosted/Dedicated.

Please sign off on the MAP and the sprint schedule by 2027-04-07 so we can lock resources:
- Emily: confirm concurrency target and sample prompt set.
- Procurement: confirm the SOW/price review window and whether 10 business days works for your legal team.
